rationale: Reviewed the accepted 72-frame audiovisual delivery; neutral, aa, ee, mbp, and rest semantic frames; mouth-only deformation over 138 vertices; preserved 4,247-vertex/7,840-triangle topology and 22-joint skeleton; isolated 48 kHz speech WAV; 25 monotonic native phoneme events and six word events; exact five-track frame grid; target compatibility; one-frame global AV placement; immutable audio, event-ledger, target-geometry, and motion hashes; and independent live semantic validation at approval.
